page.overview:
Who is Belemir?

Belemir was an Edain of the House of Bëor during the First Age.

Belemir was the son of Beldir who was a great-grandson of Bëor through his father Belen, the youngest son of Bëor. He married Adanel of the House of Marach who was the grand-daughter of Marach. It was told that Belemir had five children with Adanel, the fifth child being a son called Beren who became the grandfather of the renowned Beren the One-handed by his famed daughter Emeldir the Man-hearted. Hence, Belemir was the great-grandfather of Beren the renowned.
